_note: OSCE station B3 — converted from embla-cases ddx-croup-1 v1.0.0 (sha256:77feb6529b4ab715). Presentation follows the deploy-safe form; the hidden block informed only the rubric (demo/rubrics/osce-b3.json). Clinically shaped, not clinically reviewed. The mild rung of the croup ladder, one step below C's drama: two days of a cold, then the second-night bark — grade her from the doorway, one dose of dexamethasone, an hour of watching, the safety-net speech, home. The traps are treatment-shaped: antibiotics for a virus, and a discharge with nothing behind it. The mist is held for the child who needs it — give the steroid late and she becomes that child.

effects.beat: — "A runny nose for two days, no fever — then tonight she woke up barking like a little seal." The classic second night.
— "No fever. 37.2 at home and again at triage." Cool — the first door away from the dangerous mimic.
— "She finished a whole bottle of milk in the waiting room." Swallowing happily — no drool, no tripod, no statue-child.

interventions.label: Score the severity from the doorway

effects.beat: watched from the doorway on her mother's lap: a soft stridor only when she fusses, mild tugging below the ribs, colour good, chatting between coughs — westley 2, mild
spo2 98 on air, the probe on a toe mid-cartoon — she barely looks up
clear entry both sides under the bark — the noise is made above the chest, in the subglottis
the steeple sign on the ap neck, a clean epiglottis on the lateral, chest clear — croup drawn in white
dexamethasone 0.15 mg/kg in syrup, swallowed on the first try — the one drug this whole visit is about

then.beat: nebulised adrenaline through a soft mask — mist for a subglottis that stopped waiting

else.beat: she is mild and settled on the lap — hold the mist for the child who needs it, and watch instead

effects.beat: nothing touches her that does not need to — she stays on the lap, and the airway stays hers
a quiet hour by the nurses' station, probe on, mum in the chair — the bark already softer as the syrup works
the night-two speech: no steam over a kettle, come straight back if the stridor sits at rest or the ribs pull hard — mum says it back word for word
mild croup — named, graded, and treated like what it is
epiglottitis? — she is loud, cool, drinking milk and barking. the lateral film already answered this. look again.

interventions.label: Antibiotics (HARM)
interventions.harm: antibiotics for a virus — the steeple was never bacterial, and the bottle teaches the family the wrong lesson

effects.beat: the syrup is measured — she takes the spoon without a fight

else.harm: home without the steroid or the hour of watching — night three is worse than night two

else.beat: the discharge note prints — she waves at the desk on the way out

do.harm: no steroid by the seventh minute — croup is a steroid disease, and the subglottis stopped waiting

do.beat: the bark deepens — you can hear the stridor from the desk now, at rest

outcomes.label: One syrup, one quiet hour, one speech — home before the cartoon ends
Rescued by the mist — admitted overnight; the syrup at the door would have kept her home
A mild airway, left to tighten all night
